title: Strategic Planning and Institutional Resilience in Cairo's Health Sector: Examining the Mediating Role of Capacity Development in the Context of Environmental Crisis Management — replication package
description: Anonymised survey data (416 health-sector managers, Cairo, Egypt, 2025), bilingual codebook, analysis code (Python, R/lavaan) and outputs for a study of strategic planning, capacity development and institutional resilience in the context of environmental crisis management. Ethical approval REC/ESRI/USC/10/20-05-2025.
